Rocky Mountain Area(PL 3)   
Fire Activity and Teams Assigned Totals 
New fires: 40 
New large incidents: 1

CIMTs Committed: 2 
 
Aspen Acres, Custer County. CIMT (RM Team 3). Twenty miles southwest of Pueblo, CO. Timber. Minimal 
fire behavior with creeping, flanking and backing. Numerous structures and communication infrastructure 
threatened. Area and road closures in effect. 
 
Gold Mountain, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. CIMT (RM Team 1). CIMT is also 
managing the Elk incident. Two miles north of Ouray, CO. Grass, brush and timber. Minimal fire behavior with 
creeping, torching and smoldering. Numerous structures and critical infrastructure threatened. Area, road and 
trail closures in effect. 
 
Elk, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. Seven miles northwest of Lake City, CO. Timber, 
heavy slash and grass. Minimal fire behavior with creeping, torching and smoldering. Area, road and trail 
closures in effect. 
 
Rio Blanco, San Juan NF, USFS. Ten miles south of Pagosa Springs, CO. Timber and brush. Active fire 
behavior with running, flanking and creeping. Numerous residences threatened. Evacuations and road 
closures in effect. 
 
Willow, Pike and San Isabel NF, USFS. Six miles west of Leadville, CO. Brush, closed timber litter and timber. 
Minimal fire behavior with creeping and smoldering. Residences and communication infrastructure threatened. 
Area, road and trail closures in effect. 
 
Potato Creek, Pine Ridge Agency, BIA. Thirteen miles northeast of Kyle, SD. Grass. Moderate fire behavior 
with creeping, smoldering and single tree torching. 
 
Duhamel, Pennington County. Forty miles north of Wall, SD. Grass and timber. Minimal fire behavior. 
Precipitation occurred over the fire area yesterday. Last report unless significant activity occurs. 
 
Ferris, San Juan NF, USFS. Seven miles east of Cahone, CO. Timber and brush. Minimal fire behavior with 
smoldering. Last report unless significant activity occurs. 
 
* Pleasant Ridge, Perkins County. Ten miles north of Bison, SD. Grass. Minimal fire behavior. Structures 
threatened. Last report unless significant activity occurs.
